limitations: Dated SKU sales are unavailable; forecasts require SKU-level sales history. Store sales and period gross profit have not been converted into SKU transactions.
Sales and gross profit cover different periods and must not be added together. Gross profit uses sales and cost excluding tax. Purchases include taxes, discounts and signed purchase returns.
The stock report does not specify its snapshot date. Inventory records use the import time; confirm the stock date before making operational decisions.
Catalogue prices use the first reported location for each SKU; original cost, retail price and closing value are retained on each stock position.
Reserved stock, inbound stock, supplier lead times and reorder thresholds were not supplied. Stock coverage and replenishment recommendations require additional inputs.

findings.label: SKUs with no supplier lead time
findings.why_it_matters: Lead time sets the protection window every purchase recommendation is sized against. Without it these SKUs fall back to a 14-day assumption, which is wrong for anything imported.
findings.how_to_fix: Set `lead_time_days` per SKU (or per supplier) in your product master.

findings.label: No sales history in the last two years
findings.why_it_matters: There is nothing to forecast from. Every downstream feature — forecasts, alerts, recommendations, ROI — is inert until history is loaded.
findings.how_to_fix: Upload a sales CSV/Excel export, or connect a sales system.

findings.label: SKUs with no unit cost
findings.why_it_matters: Every rupee figure — working capital, carrying cost, ROI — is zero for these SKUs. They appear free to hold.
